about: By hand: the articles that together make one doctrine of the law (a concept), which no source groups: the article page shows them in one block with the judgments and papers that cite any of them. Each concept has its `name`, its `articles` (`<BWB id>/<article number>`, as the graph numbers them, at least two, read before they are added) and an optional `explanation`: a link to an official page that explains the concept (`label`, `url` on a government domain). No text of our own. `lawgraph curated set concept-articles`.
